title: Everyone Here Has to DANCE
premise: In a town where a band nobody knows plays on the green every Saturday and everyone has to dance, I'm the only one whose feet never move, since my best friend moved away.
twist: The band plays for the saddest person in town and won't stop until they dance, so the whole town, my grandpa's sore knees included, has been dancing all summer because I wouldn't; when I finally stand up and dance, the song ends.
world: A square town green with a white bandstand, string lights, iron benches and painted shops: a bank, a bakery, a post office, a clock tower, a moving truck on the road.
